title: the cast door refuses a ticket plan that is prose
intention: A ticket enters the store only with its plan as addressable JSON: falsifier clauses numbered 1..k, each decision's writes_to and reads, bounds in and out, and the measurements behind the why — shapes declared in the store charter and refused by name at cast_ticket.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: falsifier is a dict on 248 tickets and a string on 384, and a string on 39 of the newest 40; writes_to is set on 17 of 635, bounds on 3, though both are declared in plan_fields. The structure was tried and decayed because the door checks only non-blank. Its cost: two regex segmenters re-derive falsifier clauses from prose (proof_coverage's lettered-run heuristic, verdict_contract's numbering check), and CC hand-retyped ticket 089ad920fcc5 into a per-ticket chart script. Akien 2026-11-05: 'should be json. if we need to break up a field of prose into multiple data fields, thats cool.'
traces_to: Law 4 (the store charter's own note: 'NOTHING ENFORCES THIS TEMPLATE … an IOU'), Law 1 (prose re-read is re-derivation), CP3; idea 2026-11-05-agreed-to-a-but-i-think-this.
how: Declare plan_shapes beside plan_fields in CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json and add 'measured' to plan_fields; cast_ticket reads plan_shapes at call time and refuses every shape lack in its one pass; red-first proof over a scratch commons.
falsifier: (1) cast_ticket refuses, naming each, a falsifier that is a string or whose clauses is missing, empty, not numbered 1..k, or carries a blank claim; (2) refuses a decision line without writes_to and reads lists of non-blank strings, and a reads path that resolves to no file under the cairn root or the commons root; (3) refuses a bounds that is not {in, out} lists of non-blank strings, and a measured that is absent, empty, or has an entry lacking when (ISO date), saw or how; (4) admits and writes a doc carrying all four shapes, the builder_check seed line landing with writes_to [] and reads []; (5) the shapes are read from the store charter's plan_shapes: a scratch charter whose plan_shapes drops 'bounds' admits a doc with no bounds. Wrong intent if a real /sorted cast cannot fill writes_to/reads without guessing.

out: CairnCommons/tickets/ (the 635 standing tickets are not migrated)

decisions.text: Through `cairn artifact write`, the store charter gains 'measured' in plan_fields and a key plan_shapes: {"falsifier": {"type": "object", "required": ["clauses"], "clauses": {"items": {"n": "int, 1..k in order", "claim": "non-blank string"}}, "optional": ["wrong_intent", "horizon"]}, "decisions": {"each_requires": ["writes_to", "reads"], "lists_of": "non-blank path string", "reads_resolve": true}, "bounds": {"required": ["in", "out"], "lists_of": "non-blank string"}, "measured": {"min_items": 1, "each_requires": ["when", "saw", "how"], "when": "ISO date YYYY-MM-DD"}}, and 'falsifier', 'bounds', 'measured' join the cast's required set via a key cast_requires_shaped: ["falsifier", "bounds", "measured"]. One notes_on_the_store line records the change and this ticket id.

In cairn/tools/base/transitions.py add def _shape_lacks(doc, charter: Path) -> list[str], reading plan_shapes and cast_requires_shaped from the charter at call time (beside the plan_fields read in section (e) of cast_ticket; a charter with no plan_shapes yields []). Section (f) of cast_ticket extends lacks with it before the refusal. Lack strings: 'falsifier is not an object with clauses', 'falsifier.clauses[i] is not {n, claim}', 'falsifier.clauses numbers , not 1..k', 'decisions[i] lacks writes_to'/'reads' or 'is not a list of non-blank strings', 'decisions[i].reads

resolves to no file', 'bounds is not {in, out} lists', 'measured is absent or empty', 'measured[i] lacks ', 'measured[i].when is not an ISO date', ' is required'. reads paths resolve against the repo root (REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]) and then the commons root (tickets_dir.parent). The builder_check seed line gets 'writes_to': [] and 'reads': []. A doc with no decisions still casts.

Red-first proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_the_cast_refuses_a_plan_that_is_prose.py, shape of test_the_cast_refuses_decisions_a_rehearsal_cannot_read.py (scratch commons through artifact.set_diagnostic_roots, a scratch store charter COPIED from the live one, cast_ticket resolved at tooth time). PROVES = {'e4f02a1ceef5': {'1': 'a_prose_falsifier_is_refused', '2': 'a_pathless_decision_is_refused', '3': 'a_shapeless_bounds_or_measured_is_refused', '4': 'a_shaped_plan_casts', '5': 'the_shapes_are_read_from_the_charter'}}. Tooth 5 edits only the scratch charter.

Run the red-first proof (red at HEAD), build, run it twice serially green, plus the existing cast proofs, which must stay green — their fixture docs gain the shaped fields where the scratch charter is the live copy. Commit before the hollow reading; seal with bin/cairn test --seal <path>. The reader children 660352d41cb7, ab32ccdc4504, e6cac10b0297, 4b05529f5f49, 70f91244f3c0 reach PROVED before this crosses BUILDME; the writer child 02a4ddc2d12a follows this ticket, because its clauses (2) and (3) measure this ticket's door (admitted / a string falsifier refused) and cannot be green before it exists (2026-11-05, measured reading 02a4's falsifier).
